title: Settings
description: To set their preferred setings in home page
steps:
1.Launch the application
2.Login to the application with valid credentials.
3.Click on Setting Menu
4in the Dropdown Select Digital Landing Screen & IP Short Links
‚Ä¢ Set my default landing screen after Log in: Doctor should have provision to set my default landing screen whether OP dashboard or IP dashboard.
5.Select Default Sort for IP Dashboard
Users can select default sort option as mentioned in Doctor IP Dashboard -> Sort
‚Ä¢ Select default location:Doctors can set their default hospitals location. Whenever doctor logs in the default location will be selected in Hospital Location Dropdown.
‚Ä¢ Auto Save:Doctors can enable / disable auto save option. If doctor is entering some data in a field (Chief Complaints) and shifting/clicking next field, the data entered in Chief Complaints have to be auto saved. It is applicable for the activities on text box / multi line textbox, radio button, check box/tick box, multiple selection, dropdown or other selection like Pain score or range scroll bar in Patient Landing screen. Auto save option is not the final save. Button action like Save / Submit / Finalize needs to be clicked for the final save.
‚Ä¢ If two / multiple users are entering for same patient on same field (in patient Landing screen), then the latest saved data should be auto saved.
 IP Short links:
‚Ä¢ Doctors can sequence the short links based on their convenience. The current Short links and corresponding sequence number will be displayed here as non-editable .
‚Ä¢ After the link names have been re-numbered, a sort button should display the links in the new sort order. And the sequence is applicable to all the Patient info Cards in the IP dashboard.
6) Select default Wards:
Functionality is as per current Digital Dietician (Digital Dietician -> Settings->Select the Wards). Doctor can select max of 6 wards.
expectedResults: To set their preferred setings in home page

title: Recent Results
description: Notification of Lab results which are Recently reported
steps:
‚Ä¢ Recent Result icon to be displayed in IP Dashboard.
‚Ä¢ Recent Result icon should open Recent Result page.
‚Ä¢ Recent Result page should load max 8 patient result in first page
‚Ä¢ Recent Result Page should load 9th patient result in second page
‚Ä¢ Recent Result page should display the investigation details reported irrespective done during  IP or OP or AHC.
‚Ä¢ Recent Result page should display the investigation details reported within the selected hours (Eg: 3,6,12 24,48 hours) in dropdown.
‚Ä¢ Recent Result page users should view the investigation reports which is in draft /verified /authorized.
‚Ä¢ Recent Result page should display the colour variance on each package/Profile/Test Row.
‚Ä¢ Recent Result page should display Draft in Light yellow colour
‚Ä¢ Recent Result page should display Authorized/Verified in Light Green colour
‚Ä¢ Recent Result page should display Color legend  in Recent Results screen.
‚Ä¢ Recent Result page should display the patient tests and reports in next to next row
‚Ä¢ Result Result page should display reports based on Reported date and time and latest date and time should come first.
‚Ä¢ Recent Result page should display one patients is multiple investigations within selected filters(IP patient Type,Consulatant Name,Select ward,view records within).
‚Ä¢ Recent Result page should display clicking +(expand)  Button to expand the list of investigation done.once clicking + expand the list of investigations done. Once expanded ‚Äì button will appear & on click on ‚Äì button the patient details will get collapse.
‚Ä¢ Recent Result should display the result in Hieracrchy Level 1,2,3)
‚Ä¢ Recent Result should display the result in Hieracrchy Level
1) Package  2) Test in the package / Profile in the package  3) Test in the Profile Parameters in the test.
‚Ä¢ Recent Result should display the result On click of PDF link in Package / Profile entire tests under Package/ Profile should open in one pdf but each tests should start in a new page.
‚Ä¢ Recent Result should display the result Doctor can see the Test PDF from the Package level to Test level. On click of + button near to a Test, it will expand list of Parameters & its Result value and its Reference range and Abonormal value.
‚Ä¢ Graph Icon should display in Investigation Report.

4.Navigation to menu - > MIS Reports  - > Audit Reports->OT ->OT Utilization(Surgeon & Surgery) Report

title:

->View Surgeries
description: To verify the user able to add some activities of WardNurse PreOPActivity.
steps:
1.Launch the application
2.Login to the application with valid credentials.

4.Navigate to Functions ->Dashboards ->Common.

15.If required click on Procedure Request link.

18.Click on "Save" button.
19.If required click on Therapeutic Raise request link.	
20.Select Prescribed Date and Prescribing Doctor from the drop downs.
21.Select Replacement Fluid required radio button.
22.Select Replacement Fluid Type from the drop down.
23.Enter data in Replacement Fluid Quantity and click on "Save" button.
24.Select Drug Names from the drop down.
25.If required click on Raise Prescription link 
26.Enter data in Height and Weight and click on "Cal" button.
27.If required click on ViewPrescription hyper link which is representing with arrow mark.
28.If required click on View Drug Chart hyper link which is representing with arrow mark.
29.If required click on View Nondrug Request hyper link which is representing with arrow mark.
30.If required click on View Quicklist hyper link which is representing with arrow mark.
31.If required click on Non-drug request hyper link which is representing with arrow mark.
32.Select Item type and Item category.
33.Enter data in Search field and click search icon.
34.Select item and click on "Add" button.
35.Click on "Save" button.
36.Select radio buttons like Generic/BrandName and search data in Search for field by clicking search icon.
37.If required click on ViewPatientCounselingMessage link from search section.
38.If required click on ViewHIPaRDrugFoodMessages link from search section.
39.Enter data in  Other Specific Instruction, Surgery Description, Instructions Drugs and Instructions Others.

steps:
1.Launch the application
2.Login to the application with valid credentials.
3.Click on Common Support Services Tab and select Billing from the drop down.
4.Navigate to Functions -> Masters -> Others -> 	Package Selection Rule
5. Click on View / Modify Radio Button
expectedResults: User can able to see the PopUp Message like Role Resourceitem(s) updated successfully.

title: Reports-Admin Reports-Debtors-Customer Statement of Account-PDF
description: Verify User able to View 	Customer Statement of Account-PDF
steps:
1.Launch the application
2.Login to the application with valid credentials.
3.Click on Common Support Services Tab and select Billing from the drop down.
4.Navigate to Functions -> Reports -> Admin Reports
5. Navigate to Debtors Tab and Click on Customer Statement of Account
6. Select Customer Name
7. Enter  From Date and To Date with Difference not more than 31 Days
8. Select Report Format as PDF and Click on View Report
expectedResults:
Customer Statement of Account
Report Should be displayed in PDF Format
